promptLatex: Two lines intersect, forming four angles. One of them measures $30^{\circ}$, and the angle adjacent to it measures $x$ degrees. What is $x$?
hintLatex: Look at the two angles that together make a straight line.
Angles on a straight line have measures adding to $180^{\circ}$.
solutionLatex:
The given angle and the angle next to it together form a straight line, so they form a linear pair.
A linear pair is supplementary, meaning the two measures add to $180^{\circ}$.
Therefore $x = 180 - 30 = 150$.
